# Vellops

> Vellops builds custom AI chatbots for local business websites. The chatbot is trained on the business's own services, prices, and FAQs; it answers website visitors instantly day and night, handles customer service and sales questions, captures leads, and books appointments. Everything else runs by email: lead alerts and a Monday report (chats handled, leads captured, booked) to the owner. Vellops is a website product only — it does not call or text anyone's phone.

## About
- Business: Vellops, operated by MS ECOM LLC (Troy, Michigan), serving local businesses across the United States.
- Contact: mitchell@msecomllc.com · +1 (586) 203-9434
- Website: https://vellops.com/

## Pricing (published, no setup fee)
- Starter: $397/month — chatbot answers visitors, captures leads, email lead alerts.
- Standard: $497/month (recommended) — adds calendar booking with customer confirmations.
- Premium: $597/month — everything in Standard, priority support and monthly optimization.
- Annual billing: 2 months free ($3,970 / $4,970 / $5,970 per year).
- No setup fee. No long-term contract. Cancel by reply.
- Free 14-day live trial on the business's own website, no card required. If the chatbot books nothing in the first 30 days of a paid plan, that period is refunded in full. A 60-day performance guarantee also applies (see Terms).

## Also offered
- AI Visibility Audit: a one-time $199 audit of how a business appears in AI search answers (Google AI Overviews, Gemini), with a written report in 48 hours; the $199 is credited in full toward a Visibility Fix plan ($299/month, or $499/month with content) started within 14 days.
- Referral program: a referred business gets $100 off its first month; the referrer gets one month free when the referral becomes a paying customer.
